name: Garden Medical Clinic · Praya detail pass
description: An L-shaped garden clinic: the reception wing and consultation wing wrap a planted arrival court. A glazed return wall, garden entrance, sheltered waiting terrace and offset medical marker replace the rectangular frontage while retaining the care-room programme. September 9 successor: recessed glazing, projecting sills, connected thin blocks, framed signage and supported finishing details; original layout and identity retained.

components.role: Paved approach, drop-off edge and perimeter garden
Garden seating, flowering borders and low perimeter planting
Open-sky pocket court with a sheltered bench and specimen planting
Glazed reception, privacy windows, pale roof frame and medical marker
Reception counter, records, waiting benches and check-in screen
Patient corridor, four care bays and staff washroom division
Two furnished consultation rooms with exam couches, sinks and worktops
Treatment couch, privacy screen, supply cabinets and wash station
Staff kitchenette, lockers and separate washroom fixtures
Asymmetric arrival canopy and garden threshold
Screened ventilation plant, service walkway and green roof
